lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
lines.en: Hello! What's your name?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ jiào Wáng Míng. Nǐ ne?
lines.en: Hi! My name is Wang Ming. And you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我叫李月。认识你很高兴！
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiào Lǐ Yuè. Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng!
lines.en: I'm Li Yue. Nice to meet you!

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 认识你我也很高兴。你是学生吗？
lines.pinyin: Rènshi nǐ wǒ yě hěn gāoxìng. Nǐ shì xuésheng ma?
lines.en: Nice to meet you too. Are you a student?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Yes, I am. Goodbye!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Bye!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, Teacher Wang!

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Zhè wèi shì shéi?
lines.en: Hello! Who is this?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我介绍一下，这是我的朋友小张。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jièshào yíxià, zhè shì wǒ de péngyou Xiǎo Zhāng.
lines.en: Let me introduce — this is my friend Xiao Zhang.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 小张，你好！你在哪儿工作？
lines.pinyin: Xiǎo Zhāng, nǐ hǎo! Nǐ zài nǎr gōngzuò?
lines.en: Hi Xiao Zhang! Where do you work?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我在北京工作，我是医生。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zài Běijīng gōngzuò, wǒ shì yīshēng.
lines.en: I work in Beijing. I'm a doctor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 哦，医生！太好了。认识你很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Ò, yīshēng! Tài hǎo le. Rènshi nǐ hěn gāoxìng.
lines.en: Oh, a doctor! Wonderful. Nice to meet you.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ hǎo! Zhè jiàn yīfu duōshao qián?
lines.en: Hi! How much is this piece of clothing?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Two hundred yuan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 太贵了！便宜一点儿，好吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài guì le! Piányi yìdiǎnr, hǎo ma?
lines.en: Too expensive! Can you make it cheaper?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Then... one hundred eighty, how about that?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: OK, I'll take it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Thank you! Come again.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Waiter! We'd like to order.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Nǐmen xiǎng chī shénme?
lines.en: Sure. What would you like to eat?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我们要一个鱼，一个菜，两碗米饭。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yào yí ge yú, yí ge cài, liǎng wǎn mǐfàn.
lines.en: We'd like a fish, a vegetable dish, and two bowls of rice.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hē shénme ne? Yǒu chá hé kāfēi.
lines.en: What to drink? We have tea and coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 两杯茶，谢谢。这个鱼好吃吗？
lines.pinyin: Liǎng bēi chá, xièxie. Zhè ge yú hǎochī ma?
lines.en: Two teas, thanks. Is this fish tasty?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Very tasty! Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What's the date today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 今天十月五号。明天六号。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān shí yuè wǔ hào. Míngtiān liù hào.
lines.en: Today is October 5th. Tomorrow is the 6th.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What time is it now?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's 9:30 in the morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我们下午两点去看电影，好吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen xiàwǔ liǎng diǎn qù kàn diànyǐng, hǎo ma?
lines.en: Shall we go see a movie at 2 pm?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great! See you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, where is the train station?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: The station is not far from here.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 从这儿往前走，到那个路口往左走。
lines.pinyin: Cóng zhèr wǎng qián zǒu, dào nà ge lùkǒu wǎng zuǒ zǒu.
lines.en: Walk straight from here, then turn left at that crossing.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How long does it take to walk?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You'll be there in ten minutes.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Great, thank you!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome!

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nǐ jiā yǒu jǐ kǒu rén?
lines.en: How many people are there in your family?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ jiā yǒu wǔ kǒu rén: bàba, māma, gēge, mèimei hé wǒ.
lines.en: Five: my dad, mom, older brother, younger sister and me.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: What does your older brother do?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 他是老师，在学校工作。你妹妹呢？
lines.pinyin: Tā shì lǎoshī, zài xuéxiào gōngzuò. Nǐ mèimei ne?
lines.en: He's a teacher, he works at a school. And your younger sister?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 她还是学生。她学习汉语。
lines.pinyin: Tā háishì xuésheng. Tā xuéxí Hànyǔ.
lines.en: She's still a student. She studies Chinese.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 真有意思！我们都爱学习。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn yǒu yìsi! Wǒmen dōu ài xuéxí.
lines.en: How interesting! We all love learning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 你休息的时候喜欢做什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ xiūxi de shíhou xǐhuan zuò shénme?
lines.en: What do you like to do when you rest?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我喜欢运动。我常常跑步、游泳。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng. Wǒ chángcháng pǎobù, yóuyǒng.
lines.en: I like sports. I often run and swim.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Can you play basketball?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 会一点儿，但是踢足球踢得比较好。
lines.pinyin: Huì yìdiǎnr, dànshì tī zúqiú tī de bǐjiào hǎo.
lines.en: A little, but I play football better.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan chàng gē hé tiàowǔ.
lines.en: I like singing and dancing.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 这个星期六我们一起唱歌，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Zhè ge xīngqīliù wǒmen yìqǐ chàng gē, zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How about we sing together this Saturday?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Sure, that's great!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How's the weather today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It's cold, and it's raining.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zuótiān hěn rè, jīntiān hěn lěng.
lines.en: Yesterday was hot, today is cold.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I heard it might snow tomorrow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Zhēn de ma? Wǒ bù xǐhuan lěng tiān.
lines.en: Really? I don't like cold days.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 我喜欢。冷天可以在家喝茶。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan. Lěng tiān kěyǐ zài jiā hē chá.
lines.en: I do. On cold days you can drink tea at home.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 好，今天就去你家喝茶吧！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, jīntiān jiù qù nǐ jiā hē chá ba!
lines.en: OK, let's go to your place for tea today!

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 这个星期六你有时间吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhège xīngqīliù nǐ yǒu shíjiān ma?
lines.en: Are you free this Saturday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I am — what's up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 我们一起去看电影，怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen yìqǐ qù kàn diànyǐng, zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: Shall we go see a movie together?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure! What time?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Three in the afternoon — does that work?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: It works. Where shall we meet?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's meet in front of the school.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: OK, see you Saturday!

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 服务员，请给我一杯咖啡。
lines.pinyin: Fúwùyuán, qǐng gěi wǒ yì bēi kāfēi.
lines.en: Waiter, one coffee please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Sure, please have a seat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Your coffee.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Qǐng zài gěi wǒ yì bēi chá.
lines.en: Thanks. A cup of tea as well, please.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Coming right up.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is it altogether?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 咖啡二十块，茶十五块，一共三十五块。
lines.pinyin: Kāfēi èrshí kuài, chá shíwǔ kuài, yígòng sānshíwǔ kuài.
lines.en: The coffee is 20, the tea is 15 — 35 altogether.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Here you are. Thanks!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Excuse me, how do I get to the airport?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 机场很远，坐出租车去吧。
lines.pinyin: Jīchǎng hěn yuǎn, zuò chūzūchē qù ba.
lines.en: The airport is far — take a taxi.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much is a taxi?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Maybe about a hundred kuai.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Tài guì le. Yǒu gōnggòng qìchē ma?
lines.en: That's too expensive. Is there a bus?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: There is, but it's very slow.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi, wǒ jīntiān bù máng.
lines.en: That's fine, I'm not busy today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 公共汽车站在火车站前面。
lines.pinyin: Gōnggòng qìchē zhàn zài huǒchēzhàn qiánmiàn.
lines.en: The bus stop is in front of the train station.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Doctor, I'm sick.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: What's the matter?

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hěn lèi, yě bù xiǎng chīfàn.
lines.en: I'm very tired, and I don't feel like eating.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: When did it start?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: It started yesterday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 没关系。吃点儿药，多休息。
lines.pinyin: Méi guānxi. Chī diǎnr yào, duō xiūxi.
lines.en: Nothing serious. Take some medicine and rest a lot.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Should I drink more water?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Duì, duō hē shuǐ, duō shuìjiào.
lines.en: Yes — drink more water and sleep more.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Hello, is that Xiao Wang?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 不是，他不在。我是他弟弟。
lines.pinyin: Bú shì, tā bù zài. Wǒ shì tā dìdi.
lines.en: No, he's not in. I'm his younger brother.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Where did he go?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Tā qù xuéxiào le. Nǐ yǒu shì ma?
lines.en: He went to school. Is there something I can pass on?

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 请告诉他，明天给我打电话。
lines.pinyin: Qǐng gàosù tā, míngtiān gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: Please tell him to give me a call tomorrow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo de. Nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
lines.en: Sure. What's your name?

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: I'm Li Ming. Thanks!

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: You're welcome, goodbye!

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How much are the apples?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Five kuai each.

lines.speaker: A
lines.zh: 太贵了！便宜一点儿，可以吗？
lines.pinyin: Tài guì le! Piányi yìdiǎnr, kěyǐ ma?
lines.en: Too expensive! Can you make it a little cheaper?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Hǎo ba, sì kuài qián yí gè.
lines.en: Alright, four kuai each.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒ mǎi sān gè. Yǒu xīguā ma?
lines.en: OK, I'll take three. Do you have watermelons?

lines.speaker: B
lines.pinyin: Yǒu, xīguā hěn dà, hěn hǎochī.
lines.en: Yes — the watermelons are big and tasty.

lines.speaker: A
lines.pinyin: Nà wǒ mǎi yí gè xīguā.
lines.en: Then I'll take one watermelon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 苹果十二块，西瓜二十块，一共三十二块。
lines.pinyin: Píngguǒ shí'èr kuài, xīguā èrshí kuài, yígòng sānshí'èr kuài.
lines.en: Apples are 12, the watermelon is 20 — 32 altogether.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Xiao Li, happy birthday!

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 谢谢你们！你们来了，我很高兴。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐmen! Nǐmen lái le, wǒ hěn gāoxìng.
lines.en: Thank you! I'm so happy you came.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: How old are you today?

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: I'm twenty now.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Let's go eat together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.en: Great! You have to eat noodles on your birthday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.en: Why is that?

lines.speaker: B
lines.zh: 不知道，但是我喜欢面条！
lines.pinyin: Bù zhīdào, dànshì wǒ xǐhuan miàntiáo!
lines.en: I don't know — but I love noodles!
